author.provenance: Root-provided successful helper dispatch, no independent serving attestation

unchanged_interfaces: All public Is_Successor domain and Value-equation postconditions
premise: Existing algebraically equivalent zero-digit Prefix_Value postcondition repair in resource_quantities.ads is prerequisite; genuinely significant operands are not removed from the domain.
algorithm: Add private Trimmed_View(Data, Original) returning a Quantity view of the same original array. Keep First and Negative; decrease Length only across verified zero suffix bytes. Never rewrite, canonicalize or recopy original input storage.

Bounded reverse scan establishes Length<=Original.Length and zero suffix via structural invariant. The result has the same Digit at every offset below Original.Length; beyond that both Digit functions already return zero.

Add checked iterative Prefix_Extensionality(Data, Left, Right, Count). Loop from 0 to Count with equality of independent prefix references as invariant. At each equal zero digit use the zero recurrence without Power_Reference; at nonzero digits use the unchanged full recurrence. No recursion or imported theorem is added.

Use the existing checked Prefix_Padding(Data, trimmed, Original.Length) plus prefix extensionality to prove Magnitude equality, then Value equality with sign preserved. All these are checked body obligations, not externally trusted claims.

Extract current Is_Successor column algorithm without deleting any checks/lemmas into private Successor_Columns with the literal original value-equation contract on its supplied arguments. A new public wrapper preserves original validity/sign check order and Nonnegative_Magnitude checks on original operands, obtains checked trimmed views and returns Successor_Columns on them.

All existing Prefix_Step, Zero_Prefix, Addition_Step, Addition_Mismatch, Addition_Finish, Nonnegative_Magnitude and their bodies/contracts remain in source and full proof scope. Only their successor call operands change to equivalent shorter views. Other clients such as Magnitude_Sum_Equals are unchanged.

proposed_contracts.Trimmed_View: Pre => Span_Valid(Data, Original); Post => Span_Valid(Data, Result) and then Result.First = Original.First and then Result.Negative = Original.Negative and then Result.Length <= Original.Length and then (if Original.Length > 0 then (for all Offset in Byte_Count range 0 .. Original.Length - 1 => Digit(Data, Original, Offset) = Digit(Data, Result, Offset))) and then Value(Data, Result) = Value(Data, Original)
proposed_contracts.Prefix_Extensionality: Ghost, Global => null, Always_Terminates; Pre => Span_Valid(Data, Left) and then Span_Valid(Data, Right) and then (if Count > 0 then (for all Offset in Byte_Count range 0 .. Count - 1 => Digit(Data, Left, Offset) = Digit(Data, Right, Offset))); Post => Prefix_Reference(Data, Left, Count) = Prefix_Reference(Data, Right, Count)
proposed_contracts.Successor_Columns: Global => null; Post => Result = (Span_Valid(Data, Before) and then Span_Valid(Data, After) and then Value(Data, Before) >= 0 and then Value(Data, After) >= 0 and then Value(Data, After) = Value(Data, Before) + 1)
proposed_contracts.public_Is_Successor: Literal existing public specification remains unchanged on the original Before and After quantities.

obligations: Prove scan indexes, decreasing Length and zero-suffix invariant without assumptions or an input cap.
Prove new private Pre conditions at every call, including empty inputs, negative zero, nonzero negative refusal and invalid span refusal.
Prove prefix extensionality using the actual independent reference definitions; zero branch must not eagerly bind any radix power.
Prove trim Value equality before successor decision; formal wrapper contract must still mention original operands.
Prove extracted original column body and all inherited lemmas, not only new wrapper.
Measure checked-model recursion already present in Prefix_Reference and possible quadratic prefix evaluation; retain original time/memory/swap limits and failures.
Independently source-review exact resulting patch and whole touched semantic module before mechanical pin updates.

threshold_arithmetic.boundaries: JACKAL establishes arithmetic identities only, not Ada layout/source-to-binary refinement or runtime failure.
threshold_arithmetic.source_predicate: System.Generic_Bignums.Normalize raises Storage_Error when X.Last - J > 200 after locating the first nonzero word. System.Shared_Bignums digits have radix 2^32.
threshold_arithmetic.derivation: At most 201 significant radix-2^32 words pass this predicate. Smallest magnitude requiring word202 is 2^(201*32)=2^6432=256^804. Its minimal LE byte image is 804 zero bytes followed by 01, total805 bytes; it is not zero padding. The 804-byte all-FF input has successor 256^804.
threshold_arithmetic.runtime_correspondence: Installed runtime source read and hashed; exact statically linked library-to-runtime-source correspondence is not independently established by this proposal.

full_domain_boundary.claim: Normalization cannot make the original checked Value/Magnitude model represent 2^6432 using this unchanged Normalize implementation, even though the byte-oriented public domain admits it.
full_domain_boundary.not_claimed: No universal Ada/SPARK impossibility, no accepted narrowed guarantee, no toolchain change, no raised cap, no assertion-policy change and no successful production/full-domain proof.
full_domain_boundary.needed: Root-serialized direct checked-model counterexample and independent review, followed by a compatible full-domain checked representation design if confirmed. Original full-domain target stays open.

prepared_counterexample.input: 805-byte LE magnitude: bytes1..804=0, byte805=1. Magnitude is actually significant at byte805.
prepared_counterexample.success_criterion: Checked Magnitude assertion returns normally for this admitted quantity; any Storage_Error/other exception remains failure, never a PASS.

nonclaims: No production source modified for this proposal.
No finite padding repair closes truly significant full-domain model limitation.
